sections.title: Q3 2026 monthly infrastructure costs
sections.summary: Ledgerly infra cost report Q3 2026, monthly USD: EKS prod cluster $4,200 (3x m6i.xlarge), RDS ledger-postgres $1,850 (db.r6g.xlarge Multi-AZ), ElastiCache ledger-redis $310, SendGrid $95, Plaid $2,400 (~8,000 connected items at $0.30), EKS staging $640, Grafana Cloud $420; total $9,915/month. Covers 'how much does X cost', 'infra spend', 'plaid bill', 'postgres cost'.
